name: io.github.allooloo/cm-kg
title: Capital Markets Agents: MCP+A2A — 34 markets
description: KYP Agentic Trading with the Capital Markets Knowledge Graph — 34 markets, each served in-country.

io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.access: read-only, public-record only; no prices, quotes or licensed market data

tools.name: resolve_issuer
tools.description: Find a listed company by ticker, ISIN or LEI and return its record summary, node and current version.

tools.name: get_record
tools.description: Return the full Capital Markets Record for an issuer, with per-field source, reader and state; optionally a prior version.

tools.name: list_events_since
tools.description: Return dated, URL'd disclosure events for an issuer (releases, bulletins, halts, corporate actions, statement and record dates) since a date.

tools.name: list_aliases
tools.description: Return the sourced trade and former names an issuer releases under.

tools.name: list_nodes
tools.description: Return the market nodes on the roster of record and which are live.

io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.description_of_record: What: KYP Agentic Trading with the Capital Markets Knowledge Graph — one public-record file per listed company across the national markets on the roster (list_nodes), identity through disclosure trail, each field carrying its source and the date it was read, served from the issuer's own jurisdiction over the Model Context Protocol and the Agent-to-Agent protocol. Why: So an agent acting for a licensed capital markets participant with a Know Your Product (KYP) obligation hands back a fact that can be defended. The KYP model runs on this record. No prices, no quotes, no licensed data.
io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.estate: One regional door per market on Azure Container Apps, apex router on Cloudflare, an A2A Agent Card per node.
io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.agent_cards: https://agent.getissuer.ai/.well-known/agent-card.json (apex) and one per node in nodes_live, named on its roster entry (list_nodes: agent_card)
io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.confirmed: Confirmed current by the operator, Sept 13 2026; records confirmed against the public filing, not signed by it.
io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.counts_from: apex list_nodes at cut time (2026-10-26T21:14Z); facts at https://mcp.getissuer.ai/facts.json
